articles.headline: CoreWeave shares jump as revenue doubles and backlog hits $104 billion
articles.summary: CoreWeave’s surge signals that demand for AI cloud capacity remains intense, even as investors worry about infrastructure constraints and bubble risk. For businesses, this points to continued pressure on AI compute availability and pricing, especially for companies building AI products or buying large amounts of cloud capacity.

articles.headline: Ryanair signs five-year Google Cloud deal and expands AI use in operations
articles.summary: The deal shows how large operators are using cloud and AI to improve scheduling, customer operations, and efficiency. SMEs and larger firms should read this as evidence that AI adoption is moving from experimentation to core operational infrastructure in cost-sensitive industries.

articles.headline: Meta doubles down on open-weight AI as Zuckerberg calls for new rules
articles.summary: Meta’s move adds momentum to the open-weight AI debate and could influence how enterprises choose between proprietary and open models. Businesses should watch for downstream effects on model availability, deployment flexibility, and future regulatory expectations around AI releases.
